course.title: Leather Craft

days.title: Leather Craft Basics
days.goal: Know the tools and materials of leather craft.

quiz.q: What is saddle stitch?
options: A hand stitch using two needles through the same hole
quiz.explain: Saddle stitch passes two needles through each hole from opposite sides, making it very strong.

quiz.q: What is an awl?
options: A pointed tool for making holes in leather
quiz.explain: An awl is a sharp pointed tool used to mark and punch holes in leather.

quiz.q: Why cut leather on a mat?
options: So you do not damage the bench or the knife
quiz.explain: A cutting mat protects the bench and keeps the knife sharp.
